newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: IRAN BANDAR ABBAS PLANT TO HIT FULL CAPACITY IN SEPT. [CORRECTED 16:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: IRAN BANDAR ABBAS PLANT TO HIT FULL CAPACITY IN SEPT. [CORRECTED 16:10 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects name of plant in headline and text).
Iran's oil minister, Gholamreza Aghazadeh, said on Thursday that the Bandar Abbas refinery will start running in July and be at full capacity of 232,000 barrels per day by September.
The minister also said that a feasability study on a five million tonnes-a-year liquefied natural gas plant has been completed and has moved to the design work stage.
Aghazadeh said the refinery will reach have capacity in July. It will be an export-orientated plant but will also supply some middle distillates to the domestic market, he said.
The LNG plant will be an exporter to the Far East mainly, he said.
